newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK SAX INDEX UP ON GAINS TO SLOVNAFT.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK SAX INDEX UP ON GAINS TO SLOVNAFT.

text.p: The SAX index on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) firmed on Tuesday in moderate trading, pushed higher by gains to oil refinery Slovnaft.
Slovnaft, which posted impressive first-half results on Tuesday, added 28 crowns to 860, on 285 traded shares, boosting the 16-share SAX by 1.9 points to 170.0.
Steel maker VSZ , the most liquid stock, continued to dominate trading on the main listed floor, with 3,452 shares traded at an unchanged price of 650 crowns.
Apart from VSZ, blue chips traded only insignificant volumes and overall results were boosted by direct deals.
Overall, volume rose to 665,993 shares from 157,720 on Monday while turnover climbed to 336.8 million crowns, from 34.11 million.
